name: Will my homeowner's insurance cover roof leak water damage cleanup?

mainEntity.name: Will my homeowner's insurance cover roof leak water damage cleanup?

acceptedAnswer.text: Homeowner's insurance policies typically cover sudden and accidental water damage from a roof leak, but coverage specifics vary. Generally, damage caused by a sudden storm or unforeseen event is covered. However, damage resulting from long-term neglect, such as failure to maintain your roof or pre-existing conditions, may not be covered. It's important to review your policy details and contact your insurance provider immediately after discovering a leak to understand your coverage and begin the claims process. A professional restoration company can assist with documentation for your claim.
acceptedAnswer.description: Most homeowner's insurance covers sudden roof leak damage, but not issues from neglect. Check your policy and contact your insurer promptly after a leak.
